task1.hourly_panel: each station-month must have >=90% coverage in every hour; same stations in all 24 hours; stations then supported year-months equally weighted
task1.annual_summary: within-year annual coverage >= cutoff; observed calendar-year sums; station composition varies; unsupported years NA
task1.annual_fixed_panel: intersection over all 8 years, reported separately; no fabricated full-year totals
task1.spatial_month_selection: largest strict 90% same-month panel; earliest month resolves ties
task1.frequency_intensity: station-month wet fraction and nonzero P50/P90/P99 averaged across qualified stations then available years; not pooled quantiles

features.persistence_window: 12 exact endpoints t-3300,...,t; require all valid
features.consecutive_wet_slots_60m: trailing wet run, capped at 12 with left-censor flag
features.recency: raw age is null if no wet slot; model uses 60 censoring code with no_rain_observed_60m flag

time_contract.rule: aligned timestamp is interval end under project L1/D1 assumption
